meta.title: Xiaohongshu monitor
meta.description: Collect notes and comments with OpenCLI, and review sentiment, activity and complete capture history on the desktop.

messages.title: Xiaohongshu monitor
messages.intro: Collect notes and comments to follow sentiment and engagement over time.
messages.sourceInfo: Uses a signed-in browser connected through Browser Bridge. Samples up to 6 notes and 20 text comments and replies combined per note.
messages.placeholder: Enter a brand, product or topic
messages.commentScope: Comment share only uses text comments and replies collected in this sample.
messages.method: Negative share = negative notes ÷ notes with a title or text. Mixed and neutral notes are included.
messages.scope: Sample counts and interactions only reflect this capture, not the entire platform.
messages.limited: This capture reached the search sample limit.
messages.noResults: No identifiable Xiaohongshu notes were returned. Try another keyword.
messages.trendHelp: The latest eight captures for this keyword.
messages.historyHelp: Open a record to see its complete notes and comments without collecting again.
messages.emptyHistory: Your first completed capture will appear here.
messages.detailUnavailable: Note details are unavailable. Sentiment uses the search title.
messages.invalidSource: Only OPENCLI notes and comments is supported.
messages.collectorUnavailable: OpenCLI or Node.js could not be found. Check the setup guide and environment variables.
messages.collectorBridge: Browser Bridge is disconnected. Open the browser and enable the extension.
messages.collectorLogin: Sign into Xiaohongshu in the connected browser and try again.
messages.collectorBlocked: Xiaohongshu restricted this capture. The scan stopped.
messages.collectorBusy: An OpenCLI capture is already running.
messages.collectorFailed: OpenCLI capture failed. Check the browser connection and sign-in.
messages.collectorNoteLink: The search result is missing a link parameter required to open this note.
messages.timeout: The capture timed out. Try again.
messages.searchFailed: Capture failed. Check the connection and try again.
